response.rationale: AVNRT is strongly supported by cannon A waves, retrograde P waves (negative in II/aVF), and prior control with verapamil; the 3:2 relationship is atypical but the other features are classic. Atrial tachycardia and flutter would typically show more atrial than ventricular activity and lack cannon A waves.

rejected.why: Atrial flutter would have more atrial than ventricular activations and typical flutter waves, not present.
Atrial tachycardia would have more P waves than QRS and lacks cannon A waves.
OAVRT typically has 1:1 AV relationship and pre-excitation, not seen.
